pencil.name: Pencil
pencil.recommended_action: Purchase replacement immediately. Cease aggressive sharpening.
forensic_notes: Showed signs of wear and tear from excessive use.
Poor care contributed to accelerated decline.
Multiple sharpening incidents recorded.
Final moments were short... just like its length.
causes: Excessive sharpening during exam preparation.
Being reduced to molecular dimensions.
Aggressive eraser usage resulting in decapitation.
Unexpected snapping under academic pressure.

eraser.name: Eraser
eraser.recommended_action: Accept past mistakes without rubbing holes through reality.
eraser.last_known_words: “I rubbed away your mistakes, but who will rub away my pain?”
forensic_notes: Severe loss of bodily mass due to aggressive friction.
Puncture wounds consistent with 0.7mm mechanical pencil lead.
Fragmented along structural cleavage plane.
Died so that bad algebra might be forgiven.
causes: Furious erasure of catastrophic calculus errors.
Perforated to death by bored lead pencil stabbings during lectures.
Splitting into three uneven fragments along a stress fracture.
Dissolving into crumbly gray dust on an exam paper.

charger.name: Charger Cable
charger.recommended_action: Stop bending the cable at impossible angles.
charger.last_known_words: “If you bend me 43 degrees to the left, I might still spark...”
charger.margin_note: One angle only until the end... 🔌
forensic_notes: Terminal stress fractures detected near the connector neck.
Copper wiring exposed to standard room elements.
Victim of frequent violent unpluggings across the bedroom.
Admitted in critical tape-bound condition.
causes: Chronic one-angle-only syndrome near the connector neck.
Violent yank from the wall socket from across the bedroom.
Internal copper rupture caused by violent backpack knotting.
Mysterious 3 AM feline gnawing assault.

mug.name: Coffee Mug
mug.recommended_action: Relocate at least 15cm away from desk edges and elbows.
mug.last_known_words: “I was only two days from retirement on the top shelf...”
forensic_notes: Ceramic blunt force trauma consistent with Monday morning tile collision.
Handle amputated during rapid gesture in Zoom call.
Severe coffee tannin staining indicates heavy operational fatigue.
Glue reconstruction deemed medically futile.
causes: Catastrophic impact event caused by Monday morning uncoordination.
Thermal shock induced by hasty microwave-to-cold-sink carelessness.
Lethal handle detachment during critical coffee payload transit.
Knocked off desk corner by an overenthusiastic gesture during a Zoom call.

sock.name: Favorite Sock
sock.recommended_action: Begin partner recovery operations behind the washing machine.
sock.last_known_words: “Tell my partner in the dryer... I never stopped looking for them.”
forensic_notes: Lethal toe breach through fragile bottom yarn mesh.
Elastic tension completely flatlined; no rebound detected.
Survived 48 hostile washing machine spin cycles.
Single sock status resulted in profound psychological grief.
causes: Permanent separation from its partner in the washer-dryer wormhole.
Big toe breach through thin heel fabric during sudden sprints to the kitchen.
Elastic tissue death resulting in perpetual humiliating ankle bunching.
Devoured by the interdimensional laundry void.

shoes.name: Everyday Sneakers
shoes.recommended_action: Untie before kicking off your feet, barbarian.
shoes.last_known_words: “You never once untied my laces before shoving your foot in...”
forensic_notes: Sole flapping rhythmically during standard hallway transit.
Heel counter pulverized into structural mush.
Tread depth zero; hydroplane hazard on polished supermarket floors.
Subject walked 10,000 steps a day towards its own demise.
causes: Sole separation resulting in loud, rhythmic shoe-flapping down the hallway.
Tread erosion leading to total hydroplaning on slick supermarket tiles.
Heel counter pulverized by refusing to untie laces before shoving feet inside.
Rain puddle submersion resulting in irreversible swamp ecosystem.

earphones.name: Earphones
earphones.recommended_action: Clean the charging contacts and desist pocket tangles.
earphones.last_known_words: “My left ear is already in heaven... the right one won’t last long.”
forensic_notes: Severe volume imbalance; left driver output down to 9%.
Lithium cell battery capacity holds charge for approximately 3 minutes.
Surviving memory of a 40-minute heavy wash cycle in jeans.
Pocket knot topology exceeded Euclidean dimensions.
causes: Left audio driver permanently dropping to 12% volume.
Left behind in an airport security bin or passenger seat pocket.
Surviving a 40-minute heavy wash cycle inside denim jeans.
Lithium battery degradation capping battery life to 3 minutes and 40 seconds.

toothbrush.name: Toothbrush
toothbrush.recommended_action: Brush with circular technique, not aggressive jackhammer force.
toothbrush.last_known_words: “Why did you scrub like you were cleaning engine parts?”
forensic_notes: Bristles splayed outward in trauma resembling a deep-sea creature.
Exceeded official hygienic lifespan by four consecutive quarters.
Subject dropped twice behind the bathroom mirror cabinet.
Enamel friction exceeded recommended aerospace tolerances.
causes: Failure to survive excessive dental enthusiasm and aggressive jaw friction.
Bristles splayed into a traumatized sea anemone shape.
Plummeting into the unreachable abyss behind the bathroom mirror cabinet.
Exceeded official dental hygiene expiration by four calendar seasons.

phone_screen.name: Phone Screen
phone_screen.recommended_action: Invest in a tempered glass screen protector and non-butter fingers.
phone_screen.last_known_words: “I saw the bathroom tile rushing towards me in slow motion...”
forensic_notes: Spiderweb glass fractures spanning 94% of the capacitive surface.
Ghost touches registering spontaneous texts to ex-partners.
Display bleeding purple OLED ink across the notification bar.
Refusal to wear tempered glass armor proved fatal.
causes: Repeated exposure to gravity on unforgiving concrete sidewalks.
Lethal pocket confrontation with heavy brass apartment keys.
Face-down drop on the tile floor during 2 AM horizontal scrolling.
Hairline crack spiderwebbing into an illegible mosaic of fractured glass.

chair.name: Desk Chair
chair.recommended_action: Tighten hex bolts and stop leaning back past 45 degrees.
chair.last_known_words: “Please stop leaning back past 45 degrees, I’m begging you...”
chair.margin_note: Held the weight of your deadlines... 🪑
forensic_notes: Hydraulic cylinder failure causing slow, humiliating sinking during meetings.
Caster wheels completely immobilized by accumulated hair and carpet lint.
Armrest cushion permanently crushed into a geological depression.
Lumbar support plastic fractured under gaming tilt stress.
causes: Hydraulic cylinder failure causing slow, humiliating sinking during meetings.
Structural lumbar crack during prolonged dramatic gaming tilts.
Caster wheels completely immobilized by accumulated hair and carpet lint.
Armrest cushion permanently crushed into a geological depression.

water_bottle.name: Water Bottle
water_bottle.recommended_action: Hand wash rubber gaskets to avoid bio-hazard mold colonies.
water_bottle.last_known_words: “That bottom dent makes me wobble whenever you put me down...”
water_bottle.closing_doodle: Stay hydrated on the other side.
forensic_notes: Concave base trauma prevents upright orientation on flat tables.
Black mold gasket civilization advancing to industrial-era technology.
Left behind under gym benches and library desks, yet returned.
Cap thread stripping leading to insidious backpack book-flooding.
causes: Severe bottom dent preventing the vessel from standing upright without tipping.
Black mold gasket civilization advancing to industrial-era technology.
Abandoned under a gym weight bench or library desk forever.
Lid thread stripping leading to insidious backpack book-flooding.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.recommended_action: Cease transporting three heavy textbooks and an unsealed shake.
backpack.last_known_words: “You didn’t need to pack three giant textbooks AND a hoodie...”
backpack.margin_note: Carried your burdens until the end... 🎒
forensic_notes: Main zipper teeth rupture caused by packing unreasonable volumes.
Right shoulder strap thread giving up at 8:55 AM on campus.
Gel pen cap loss resulting in permanent ink hemorrhage inside.
Bottom fabric abrasion resulting in spontaneous laptop exit.
causes: Main zipper teeth rupture caused by packing three oversized textbooks and a hoodie.
Right shoulder strap thread giving up at 8:55 AM on campus.
Gel pen cap loss resulting in permanent ink hemorrhage in bottom compartment.
Bottom fabric wear-through resulting in spontaneous laptop ejection.

custom.name: Custom Subject
custom.recommended_action: Treat with immediate reverence before entropy claims it.
custom.last_known_words: “I did my best in an uncaring universe.”
forensic_notes: Physical integrity compromised by standard terrestrial physics.
Material fatigue outpaced owner maintenance protocols.
Exhibited dramatic signs of terminal existential decline.
Entropy claimed another faithful everyday companion.
causes: Mysterious structural decay under the harsh laws of physics.
Neglect in the bottom drawer of forgotten relics.
Sudden catastrophic failure during the moment it was needed most.
Accelerated entropy induced by owner indifference.
